institute.meta.title: WPA Institute | Research, Protocol, Diplomacy & AI Governance
institute.meta.description: World Protocol Academy Institute — part of an independent digital educational, research and authorial platform in development, testing and pilot phase — 2026, focused on protocol, diplomacy, public communication, security studies, Protocolometry, WPAWS, publications and human-governed AI workflows.
institute.hero.lead: Within World Protocol Academy, the Institute connects academic theory, verifiable public sources, professional practice, Protocolometry and human-governed AI workflows across protocol, diplomacy, public communication and security studies.
institute.identity.title: WPA Institute within World Protocol Academy
institute.identity.subtitle: Independent digital educational, research and authorial platform
institute.identity.p1: The Institute is a specialised WPA research, educational, analytical and authorial layer for protocol, diplomacy, public communication and security studies, operating within World Protocol Academy's development, testing and pilot phase — 2026.
institute.identity.p2: World Protocol Academy does not present itself as a university, state academy, accreditation body or degree-granting institution. Its methods, analytical tools and educational materials are developed within an independent authorial and research platform.
institute.identity.p3: The Institute connects theory, verifiable sources, professional practice and measurable methods while preserving human authority, evidence discipline and clear institutional boundaries.
